Name: Starmastery Valley
Author: war77
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54588/54588-1792945770-2074592866.png[/img]

With Starmastery Valley, every tool, weapon, food, or any item in the game, has its own progression system.

When you simply interact with any item, it gets added to your starmastery list in your inventory.

By using those items they gain exp, when you level up the item it starts to gain bonuses. Each item type has its own bonuses.

Leveling up your water can will require less water to use and use less energy to water items with.

Leveling up a pasnip will make the parsnips worth more when you sell them.

Every item can be leveld up simply by using them, giving you more than just the base skills to level up while playing.

Manifest.Name: Starmastery Valley
Manifest.Description: Standalone per-item mastery progression with an inventory mastery tab, persistent item levels, configurable XP sources, and item-specific bonuses.
